verdict.rationale: Digits documents a public Connect API with OAuth 2.0 authorization-code auth and granular scopes, route-based versioning, and a free self-serve resettable sandbox. Its reference covers both reads and writes: financial statements, chart of accounts, ledger queries, idempotent batch transaction sync, webhooks, and a full bills workflow. Agent-friendly surfaces include a claimed OpenAPI 3.0 spec and a live llms.txt and .md docs mirror confirmed by probes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API calls, and verification of the OpenAPI spec itself (the probed spec paths returned 404, and the documented /openapi path was not tested).
